# Confused Catholic

> This site is host to a variety of resources for Christians who believe in Sacramental faith and Apostolic succession.

## Blog

- hosted at [https://www.confusedcatholic.com/blog](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/blog)
- reflections, meditations and essays on the Catholic faith, Sacraments, and Apostolic Christianity

## Interlinear Bibles

- hosted at [https://www.confusedcatholic.com/bibles](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/bibles)
- Free interlinear Bibles in [Latin/English](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/bibles/clementine-vulgate-douay-rheims/), [Greek/English](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/bibles/greek-patriarchal-kjv-interlinear/), and [Paleo-Hebrew/Hebrew/English](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/bibles/hebrew-tanakh-leeser-translation/)
- Each page is one full interlinear text from start to finish. For instance, the entire Latin/English Bible is served once, on a single page, with scrolling functionality and tables of contents that allow the user to navigate intuitively with no need for additional page load

## Patristics

- hosted at [https://www.confusedcatholic.com/patristics](https://www.confusedcatholic.com/patristics)
- an growing curation of patristic texts
